result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion. It preserves the existing termination-payment provision and is professionally drafted. However, it goes beyond the playbook by adding a prohibition on deleting, withholding, or suspending data to enforce obligations and by extending the return obligation to all Company Confidential Information, so it is not strictly minimal.
